nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation (CNG)
nodes.rationale: ios/ and android/ are generated; configure native behavior in app.json and config plugins instead of editing by hand.

nodes.label: Development build (vs Expo Go)
nodes.rationale: Expo Go only includes bundled native modules; libraries with native code need a development build.

nodes.label: Expo CLI commands (expo install, lint, tsc, doctor)
nodes.norm_label: expo cli commands (expo install, lint, tsc, doctor)
nodes.rationale: Use npx expo install rather than npm add to resolve SDK-compatible versions; run lint and typecheck before finishing.

nodes.label: Fetch versioned Expo docs (do not trust training data)
nodes.norm_label: fetch versioned expo docs (do not trust training data)
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release so remembered APIs are likely renamed, moved or removed.

nodes.label: Boundary rule (eslint-plugin-boundaries)
nodes.rationale: Features may import only core, own files, or another feature's index.ts; core cannot import features/app; keeps feature internals encapsulated.

nodes.label: Environment check (Node, JDK, Android SDK)
nodes.rationale: JDK 26 present but React Native/Gradle needs JDK 17; Android SDK and emulator missing; nothing installed without asking.

nodes.label: Installed packages
nodes.rationale: react-test-renderer pinned to 19.3.0 to avoid ERESOLVE conflict with react 19.3.0.
